reader.requirement: At --std 85 each SORT key data-name must resolve, possibly qualified, to an item described in a record description of the SD (any one of several), which is not a group containing a variable-occurrence item, whose entry carries no OCCURS and is not subordinate to one carrying OCCURS, and which lies within the first x character positions (x the minimum record size) when the SD's records vary in length. A key violating any of a, c, e or f is refused; b and d are admissions.

edition-consulted.switches: VaryingRecordInfo.BoundsEnforced for a Format 3 RECORD CONTAINS integer-4 TO integer-5 SD = DialectBehavior.RecordContainsRangeBindsRecordSize (from 2002); FileModel.VaryMin, the x of item f, is the smallest record description at 85 and integer-4 from 2002

reader.edition-search: grep of Edition, DialectLevel, Year <, DialectBehavior, CobolVersion in SortBinder.cs, SortKeyAdmission.cs, RecordLayout.cs and DataBinder.ScreenDataNameShape: the key predicate and the window walk are edition-neutral; the one consult on the path is the Format 3 bounds flag behind VaryMin
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: yes, for item f with a Format 3 SD only: c5-f-format3 (RECORD CONTAINS 2 TO 8, records of 8 and 4, key at 3..4) is admitted at --std 85 (x = 4, the smallest record described, §1985:VII.3.8.4 GR14) and refused COBOL0874 at --std 2023 (x = integer-4 = 2); every other probe is the same code at both editions
reader.witnesses-cover: part: the witnesses cover a key outside the record, a group key over an ODO table, a key from the second record, an OCCURS key and an index-data-item key; not exercised: a qualified key, a key subordinate to an OCCURS entry, a group key containing a fixed OCCURS (legal), item f for RECORD VARYING and Format 3, a key straddling the minimum size, signed and edited keys

reader.notes: SortAddFileKeys and SortKeyAdmission.Violation implement a, c, e and f, and admit b and d; every lettered refusal and admission probed at --std 85 matched, including runtime order. One reading question for the refuter: §1985:II.6.2.2.1.3 calls the record entries of files in one SAME RECORD AREA clause 'associated', and the compiler refuses a key described in such a peer FD's record (c5-a-samerec), at 2023 too. I read SR4a's 'records associated with file-name-1' as the SD's own entries, as SR4d does.

refuter.evidence: Item f's x is 'the minimum record size specified for the file referenced by file-name-1'. For a format 3 SD at --std 85 the compiler takes x = FileModel.VaryMin = Records.Min(MinRecordSize) (ODO table at minimum occurrences), but §1985:VII.3.8.4 GR15 (FORMAT 3; SD RECORD clause per §1985:XI.3.2.4 GR2) sizes each record at the maximum of its variable items. Probe E:/COBOL-coord/scratch/sample-shared/out/refute-1985-08/r5-f3odo-key.cob: SD RECORD CONTAINS 6 TO 7 CHARACTERS over 01 SR (SN PIC 9, ST PIC X OCCURS 1 TO 5 DEPENDING ON SN: GR15 size 6) and 01 SR2 (SA XX, SB XX, SC XXX: 7); KEY SB at 3..4. Under either reading of 'specified' (integer-4 = 6, or the smallest record described = 6) x = 6 and the key is admitted. --std 85: COBOL0874 'SW describes variable-length records with minimum size 2 — all key data items shall be contained within the first 2 bytes' (rejects legal source); --std 2023: RAN. A second, weaker point: the reader's c5-f-format3 (RECORD CONTAINS 2 TO 8 over records 8 and 4, key 3..4) is admitted at 85 with x = 4, while SR4f's 'specified' can be read as integer-4 = 2 (refuse). cite.py: 'OK §1985:XI.4.4.3 SR4f ... the text is in SR4f'; 'OK §1985:VII.3.8.4 GR15 ... the text is in GR15'; 'OK §1985:VII.3.8.4 GR5a ... the text is in GR5a' (the minimum-occurrence rule is Format 2's).
edition-sites-missed: src/WiseOwl.Cobol.Compiler/Binding/Model/FileModel.cs#VaryMin: the 85 Format 3 arm (BoundsEnforced false) sizes x with an ODO table at its minimum occurrences instead of GR15's maximum
refuter.corrected: NON-CONFORMING, cause (a): at --std 85 item f's x for a format 3 SD whose record has an OCCURS DEPENDING ON table is computed with the table at minimum occurrences; GR15 sizes the record at the maximum, so a legal key (r5-f3odo-key, x = 6, key 3..4) is refused COBOL0874. Harm: rejects-legal-source. At --std 2023 it compiles (x = integer-4 = 6).

adjudication.reason: Mechanism 1 UPHELD, cause (a): at --std 85 a format 3 record holding an OCCURS DEPENDING ON table is sized at the table's minimum, where §1985:VII.3.8.4 GR15 sizes it at the maximum; harm both ways. The file names no verdict word for this mechanism: PARTIAL is the inventory's verdict for code that breaks part of the rule, the refuter's corrected verdict (NON-CONFORMING) in the vocabulary.
